## Teaching points

1. A high-output ileostomy can cause rapid salt and fluid depletion. Reassess urine output, electrolytes and perfusion after replacement.
2. Reassess perfusion after each fluid increment and replace ongoing losses; use oral glucose-saline solutions when safe.
3. Creatinine recovery lags behind better blood pressure. Check magnesium and potassium and involve the stoma team in preventing recurrence.
